tests.title: AC-19401-5: rcf audit coverage with AC-101-1 superseded by AC-101-2 (no TC) and AC-101-2 bound to a resolving TC exits 0, the row reads "retired (AC-101-2)", json state "retired" supersededBy "AC-101-2" covered false totals.retiredAcs 1, mermaid "AC-101-1 -. supersededBy .-> AC-101-2", shallow-any exits 0

AC-19401-6: rcf audit coverage with AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-9 absent from the chain exits 4 printing "supersession: AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-9: successor not found in the chain"; --mode shallow-any prints it and exits 0; rcf define validate exits 0

AC-19401-7: rcf audit coverage with AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-1 exits 4 printing "supersession: AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-1: a criterion cannot supersede itself"; --mode shallow-any prints it and exits 0; rcf define validate exits 0

AC-19401-8: rcf audit coverage with AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 superseding each other exits 4 printing one line "supersession: AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-2: cycle AC-101-1 -> AC-101-2 -> AC-101-1"; --mode shallow-any prints it and exits 0; rcf define validate exits 0

AC-19401-9: rcf audit coverage with a resolving TC still bound to retired AC-101-1 and no TC on AC-101-2 exits 4 with REQ-001 uncovered; the AC-101-1 row reads "retired (AC-101-2)" and lists the TC, json keeps it in testCases, and it counts toward nothing

AC-19401-10: rcf audit coverage with retired AC-101-1, covered AC-101-2 and uncovered AC-101-3 exits 4 with REQ-001 uncovered and AC-101-3 "no"; AC-101-1 never reads "yes" or covered true in strict or shallow-any mode

AC-19401-11: rcf audit eval coverage --strict with retired nonDeterministic AC-101-1 and no EVAL exits 0 reading outcome "retired" supersededBy "AC-101-2" and missingCount 0; a live nonDeterministic AC-101-3 with no EVAL still reads "missing" and exits 4

AC-19401-12: rcf verify run --mode deterministic never requests the probe path of retired AC-101-1, records it "retired" with evidence.supersededBy "AC-101-2", never "pass" or "fail", counts it under neither verified nor failed, and exits 0 when AC-101-2 passes

AC-19401-18: rcf audit coverage --with-code with retired AC-101-1 (named by a Code Node) and retired AC-101-3 (none), both superseded by covered AC-101-2, exits 0 as without --with-code, both rows read "retired (AC-101-2)" with Code "retired", json codeClass "retired" and codeTotals 1, 0, 0
